# Abasiofon Sendan — Backend Engineer

Backend engineer based in Nigeria. Builds APIs, webhook delivery systems, and data pipelines. 5+ years shipping backend systems.

## Stack

Python, Django, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, SQLite, Supabase, Go, Redis, Docker

## What I Do

- Design and build REST APIs
- Webhook delivery infrastructure (Go)
- Rate limiting, background jobs, event-driven systems
- Database design and query optimization

## Experience

**Backend Engineer — Acme Corp (2023–present)**
Owner of the webhook delivery service and API layer. Shipped eventbridge (webhook delivery API in Go). Cut failed deliveries from 6% to under 0.5%. Introduced an outbox pattern across services.

**Backend Engineer — Startly (2021–2023)**
Built APIs and background jobs for a SaaS product. Designed a Redis-backed rate limiter that survived a 40x traffic spike. Migrated in-memory state to Redis.
